interpretation: n counts successive uniform phase-time steps; each step advances normalized elapsed cycle time by 1.25% of an unspecified reference cycle duration.

phaseTime.referenceDurationStatus: T_cycle unspecified: percentage is normalized time, not an absolute physical duration
phaseTime.normalizedEndConvention: n=80 is the completed endpoint, equivalent in cyclic phase to n=0 at the next turn

angleMapping.note: 4.5° phase steps do not exactly align with six external 60° slot boundaries: one slot is 13 1/3 steps.

lengthMapping.countType: symbolic integrated length fraction, not speed/time

cautions: User-defined phase-time percentage specifies progress through a cycle, not an independently measured duration in seconds.
n is constrained to integers 0 through 80 for a single completed cycle; repetition may use modulo 80 with an explicit cycle index.
One 80-step internal phase cycle is 360°, distinct from the optional six-segment external ring.
The 80-step phase grid does not divide the optional 60° outer slots into integer ticks; do not silently round or assert exact alignment.
No physical Planck time or new physics is established by normalized phase-time indexing.
Existing v8.0 and older frozen registers remain unchanged.
